categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, production, processing, and sales of new energy battery cathode materials and precursors, including nickel-based, cobalt-based, phosphate-based, and sodium-based materials, as well as new energy metals. These products are used in new energy vehicles, energy storage, consumer electronics, low-altitude economy, artificial intelligence, and robotics. The company also operates upstream in nickel resource mining and refining, and downstream in recycling and circular economy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced multi-stage tandem co-precipitation technology for customized synthesis of precursors with gradient concentration and structure. It has developed ultra-low-cost single crystal precursor synthesis, high-voltage oriented single crystal and polycrystalline precursor technologies, and customized pore-forming techniques for high-nickel precursors. It also innovates in high-voltage cobalt oxide synthesis, nano hydroxyl cobalt, and liquid phase co-precipitation for phosphate and sodium battery materials. The company integrates resource extraction, refining, material manufacturing, and recycling into a closed-loop industrial chain.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global lithium battery manufacturers and new energy vehicle companies such as Tesla, Samsung SDI, LG Chem, CATL, BYD, SK On, and Panasonic. The company serves industries including new energy vehicles, energy storage, consumer electronics, low-altitude economy (eVTOL, drones), AI, and robotics. Its products are critical for battery cathode materials and precursors used in these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with major industrial bases in Guizhou, Hunan, Guangxi, and overseas in Indonesia, Singapore, Hong Kong, South Korea, Morocco, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Finland, and Zimbabwe. Its sales cover domestic and international markets including Asia, Europe, and North America, with overseas sales accounting for over 44% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the lithium-ion battery supply chain, primarily in the midstream segment producing cathode materials and precursors. It also has upstream operations in nickel mining and refining, and downstream activities in battery material recycling, forming an integrated closed-loop supply chain from raw materials to recycling.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include technology diversification, global development, digital operations, and industrial ecology. R&D focuses on high-nickel and phosphate materials, solid-state battery precursors, high-voltage cobalt materials, sodium battery materials, and recycling technologies. The company emphasizes cost reduction, performance enhancement, and new application development in AI, robotics, low-altitude economy, and solid-state batteries. It maintains strong collaboration with top universities and industry leaders to sustain innovation leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of battery cathode materials, precursors, and new energy metals. Pricing is based on raw material costs plus processing fees. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and financial asset management. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in nickel-based ternary precursor materials with a 20.3% market share, and holds the top position in cobalt-based materials with a 28% market share. It ranks among the top in phosphate and sodium battery materials. Competitors include CATL, LG Chem, Samsung SDI, BYD, and other major battery material producers. The company leverages technological innovation, integrated supply chain, and global customer base to maintain industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 40.22 billion, a 17.36% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 1.47 billion, with a slight decline due to market conditions. Total assets reached RMB 73.02 billion, up 17.43%, and net assets were RMB 20.14 billion. The company has shown steady growth in production capacity and sales volume, especially in new energy metals, which grew nearly 298%. It maintains a healthy financial structure with an asset-liability ratio around 59.62%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technological leadership, product quality, and scale to deliver high-performance, cost-effective battery materials. Its multi-material product matrix and integrated supply chain from resource mining to recycling provide competitive advantages. Advanced synthesis technologies enable customized, high-capacity, long-life, and fast-charging materials tailored for emerging applications like solid-state batteries, AI, robotics, and low-altitude economy. Strong global partnerships and a diversified customer base ensure stable supply and market expansion.
